description.narrative:
The UN JP aims to strengthen urban and rural resilience and the conditions for recovery in Syria.
It included three outcomes: 1) Women, men, girls and boys have more equitable basic services, such as electricity, water, education and health care. 2) Women, men, girls and boys have enhanced sustainable food systems and livelihood opportunities. 3) Trust, cohesion and cross-cleavage cooperation between local communities is enhanced.

JP programmet har tre övergripande resultatområden: 1) Att ge befolkningen en mer rättvis tillgång till grundläggande samhällsservice såsom; electricitet, vatten, utbildning och hälsa. 2) Att ge befolkningen förbättrade försörjningsmöjligheter och hållbara livsmedelssystem. 3) Att främja samexistens och samarbete mellan olika samhällsgrupper.

The UN JP is a setup with the aim to strengthen urban and rural resilience and the conditions for recovery in Syria. It include three outcomes: 1) Women, men, girls and boys have more equitable basic services, such as electricity, water, education and health care. 2) Women, men, girls and boys have enhanced sustainable food systems and livelihood opportunities. 3) Trust, cohesion and cooperation between local communities is enhanced. These outcomes match well the aim of the Swedish Syria crisis strategy 2024-2026.

6.b - Stödja och stärka lokalsamhällenas deltagande i arbetet med att förbättra vatten- och sanitetshanteringen.
